mistakes.text: The wooden paddle dipped into the green water on both sides.
mistakes.normalized: the wooden paddle dipped into the green water on both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pádlo samo nič nerobí, preto treba Passive s „was“: „was dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pádlo samo nic nedělá, proto je potřeba Passive s „was“: „was dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The paddle doesn't act by itself, so use Passive with “was”: “was dipped”.

mistakes.text: The wooden paddle was dip into the green water on both sides.
mistakes.normalized: the wooden paddle was dip into the green water on both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Passive patrí za „was“ past participle: „dipped“, nie „dip“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Passive patří za „was“ past participle: „dipped“, ne „dip“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Passive needs the past participle after “was”: “dipped”, not “dip”.

mistakes.text: The wooden paddle is dipped into the green water on both sides.
mistakes.normalized: the wooden paddle is dipped into the green water on both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa odohral v minulosti, preto „was dipped“, nie „is dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj proběhl v minulosti, proto „was dipped“, ne „is dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use “was dipped”, not “is dipped”.

mistakes.text: The wooden paddle was dipped into the green water from both sides.
mistakes.normalized: the wooden paddle was dipped into the green water from both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prirodzenejšie je „on both sides“, teda z jednej aj druhej strany loďky.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Přirozenější je „on both sides“, tedy z jedné i druhé strany lodičky.
mistakes.feedback_en: “On both sides” sounds more natural here than “from both sides”.

mistakes.text: The wooden paddle was dipped to the green water on both sides.
mistakes.normalized: the wooden paddle was dipped to the green water on both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri pohybe dovnútra niečoho patrí „into“, nie „to“: „into the green water“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U pohybu dovnitř něčeho patří „into“, ne „to“: „into the green water“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For movement inside something use “into”, not “to”: “into the green water”.

mistakes.text: Someone dipped the wooden paddle into the green water on both sides.
mistakes.normalized: someone dipped the wooden paddle into the green water on both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje Passive: podmetom je pádlo, teda „the paddle was dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje Passive: podmětem je pádlo, tedy „the paddle was dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: the paddle is the subject, “the paddle was dipped”.

mistakes.text: They dipped the wooden paddle into the green water on both sides.
mistakes.normalized: they dipped the wooden paddle into the green water on both sides
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje Passive: podmetom je pádlo, teda „the paddle was dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje Passive: podmětem je pádlo, tedy „the paddle was dipped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: the paddle is the subject, “the paddle was dipped”.

source_issues: Slovak “bolo ponárané” and Czech “bylo ponořováno” are imperfective (repeated dipping); “was being dipped” is accepted too.
